scope: First-pass state prioritization research. Allegations in complaints are not treated as verified facts unless independently established.

events.title: Minnesota AG sues GoodLeap and other solar lenders over alleged hidden dealer fees
events.status: ongoing litigation; discovery reported after jurisdictional issues resolved in January 2025
events.notes: Primary state enforcement action. AG alleged approximately $35 million in hidden fees across nearly 5,000 Minnesota solar loans involving the four lender defendants.

events.title: Commonwealth of Virginia sues former Power Home/Pink Energy principals and multiple lenders including GoodLeap
events.status: active federal litigation in 2026
events.notes: Primary AG action. The amended complaint alleges widespread deceptive solar sales and financing practices affecting Virginia consumers and includes allegations concerning lender knowledge of consumer complaints.

events.title: GoodLeap v. McGrew appellate decision involving a residential solar loan
events.status: default judgment reversed and matter remanded
events.notes: Underlying pro se suit asserted fraud, forgery, contract, warranty, Texas DTPA and unjust-enrichment claims. Useful for arbitration/service/litigation research, not proof of the underlying allegations.

events.title: GoodLeap v. Garza appellate decision compelling arbitration
events.status: trial-court denial of arbitration reversed
events.notes: Underlying allegations concerned Spanish-language door-to-door solar sales, promised savings and promised additional work/benefits.

events.title: Ramos v. GoodLeap and solar companies
events.status: claims against GoodLeap compelled to arbitration and case stayed
events.notes: One of several recent Texas federal solar-financing cases involving GoodLeap.

events.title: Elejarza v. GoodLeap, TriSMART Solar and others
events.status: arbitration granted; case stayed/administratively closed
events.notes: Truth in Lending case; reinforces Texas as a high-density GoodLeap litigation state.

events.title: GoodLeap sues Solar Cancellation Resource Center and Consumer Advocacy Law Group
events.status: active federal litigation in 2026
events.notes: Directly relevant to the future cancellation-company research lane, but should remain within GoodLeap research only where the litigation itself is discussed.

events.title: Johnson v. Expert and GoodLeap
events.status: claims against GoodLeap compelled to arbitration and stayed
events.notes: Putative class action arising from a solar contract and financing.

events.title: Shoukat v. GoodLeap and Titan Solar entities
events.status: litigation continued after Titan bankruptcy-related events; 2025 opinion granted default judgment against Sunbeam
events.notes: Strong GoodLeap + failed-installer research connection for New Jersey.

events.title: Govinda v. Suntuity, GoodLeap and CoreFusion Solar
events.status: GoodLeap dismissed by stipulation after settlement in 2024; later proceedings continued against other defendants
events.notes: Solar financing dispute involving a Suntuity project. Useful failed/changed-installer ecosystem example.

events.title: Ball v. GoodLeap involving Titan Solar Power Missouri bankruptcy
events.status: GoodLeap claims compelled to arbitration; Titan bankruptcy remained relevant to case posture
events.notes: Direct example of an installer bankruptcy intersecting with an active GoodLeap financing dispute.

events.title: Coordinated Pink Energy/Power Home Solar litigation includes GoodLeap-financed consumers
entities: Power Home Solar d/b/a Pink Energy
events.status: GoodLeap claims in coordinated Ohio cases were directed to arbitration; Pink Energy filed bankruptcy in 2022
events.notes: Large multi-case cluster tied to a major installer collapse.

events.title: McConville v. GoodLeap transferred into Michigan Pink Energy companion litigation
entities: Power Home Solar d/b/a Pink Energy
events.status: GoodLeap motion to compel arbitration granted in 2024
events.notes: Companion to broader Pink Energy litigation and useful for organizing multi-state installer-collapse research.

events.title: Arias v. GoodLeap arbitration motion denied
events.status: GoodLeap motion to dismiss/compel arbitration denied
events.notes: Recent merits-relevant arbitration ruling in a residential solar financing dispute. Complaint allegations should remain clearly labeled as allegations.

events.title: Montgomery v. GoodLeap litigation over arbitrability, credit reporting and debt-collection claims
events.status: court ordered further proceedings/trial on arbitrability issue
events.notes: Recent case with an unusual live dispute over whether arbitration can be compelled.

events.title: Meche v. Green Light Solar and GoodLeap
entities: Green Light Solar, LLC of Texas
events.status: filed May 2026
events.notes: Recent federal consumer case connecting installer and financing issues.

events.title: Zarate v. Freedom Forever Oregon and GoodLeap
events.status: active in 2026
events.notes: Recent GoodLeap + Freedom Forever consumer dispute.

events.title: Davidson v. GoodLeap
events.status: federal Truth in Lending case filed in 2025
events.notes: Recent Nevada GoodLeap litigation; needs deeper complaint review before editorial use.

events.title: Purnell v. GoodLeap and solar defendants
events.status: federal litigation produced a 2023 memorandum opinion
events.notes: Older but substantive Pennsylvania solar-financing case.

events.title: Hansen v. Valor Roof and Solar and GoodLeap
events.status: federal Truth in Lending litigation
events.notes: Useful historical Colorado case; lower current priority than 2025-26 clusters.

events.title: Taylor v. GoodLeap putative class action
events.status: motion to compel arbitration pending in summer 2026 docket materials
events.notes: Recent class-action filing; underlying allegations require complaint-level review before use.

events.title: CFPB solar financing issue spotlight
events.status: published federal consumer-finance research
events.notes: The CFPB discusses hidden dealer fees, tax-credit representations, payment re-amortization and savings claims, and cites the Minnesota v. GoodLeap complaint as a source.

events.title: Freedom Forever Chapter 11 filing includes proposed settlement with GoodLeap
events.status: Chapter 11 proceedings in Delaware in 2026
events.notes: Bankruptcy motion states Freedom Forever and GoodLeap had a program agreement and describes GoodLeap as a critical partner. This is a national installer-finance relationship that can support state-specific follow-up where affected customers are found.
